scope: Fixed-policy scheduling overhead across the P4-001 structural scenario catalog

configuration.timedRegion: One TryRunImmediate/TryRunBudgeted/TryRunBatchedJobsSameFrame call (one tick) over a freshly created agent set
configuration.excludedFromTimedRegion: Agent construction/disposal, JSON serialization, GC.Collect calls between cases

scenarios.name: scheduling-baseline-empty-job
scenarios.isolates: The fixed per-tick overhead of beginning and completing an update on the smallest possible tree (one leaf), isolated from any node-execution cost.

scenarios.name: shallow-tree-cheap-conditions
scenarios.isolates: A small, flat sequence of cheap leaves -- the common case for simple agent behavior.

scenarios.name: deep-sequence-selector-traversal
scenarios.isolates: Traversal cost through many nested composite levels before reaching a leaf.

scenarios.name: wide-branching-frequent-failures
scenarios.isolates: A wide composite where most children fail, isolating early-exit/failure-path cost.

scenarios.name: predominantly-running-actions
scenarios.isolates: Leaves that stay Running every tick, isolating the cost of resuming an already-entered tree without re-traversal.

scenarios.name: many-programs-small-populations
scenarios.isolates: Many distinct small compiled programs with few agents each, isolating per-program (not per-agent) scheduling overhead.

documentedNotYetImplementedScenarios.name: event-driven-sleeping-wakeup
documentedNotYetImplementedScenarios.isolates: Agents that sleep until an external wakeup event.

documentedNotYetImplementedScenarios.name: high-command-emission
documentedNotYetImplementedScenarios.isolates: Leaves emitting many commands per tick.

documentedNotYetImplementedScenarios.name: computationally-expensive-burst-nodes
documentedNotYetImplementedScenarios.isolates: Leaves with deliberately expensive Burst-compiled work.

documentedNotYetImplementedScenarios.name: mixed-cheap-and-expensive-agents
documentedNotYetImplementedScenarios.isolates: A population mixing cheap and expensive agents/trees.

documentedNotYetImplementedScenarios.name: managed-node-boundary
documentedNotYetImplementedScenarios.isolates: Trees crossing into a managed (non-Burst) node.

documentedNotYetImplementedScenarios.name: same-frame-pipelined-budgeted-execution
documentedNotYetImplementedScenarios.isolates: Direct latency comparison across policies including PipelinedJobs (P4-003).

documentedNotYetImplementedScenarios.name: hot-reload-debug-instrumentation-overhead
documentedNotYetImplementedScenarios.isolates: Overhead of debug instrumentation / hot reload while running.

documentedNotYetImplementedPolicies.name: PipelinedJobs
documentedNotYetImplementedPolicies.isolates: Cross-frame pipelined batch scheduling latency/throughput (P4-003 implements the policy itself; this harness will then measure it, not before).

documentedNotYetImplementedPolicies.name: Auto
documentedNotYetImplementedPolicies.isolates: Adaptive policy selection (P4-005/P4-007; OQ-006 gates whether this is ever built at all).

limitations: This isolated Windows Editor batchmode run measures one workstation; it is not a cross-hardware-class result (Planning~/USER_ACTIONS.md).

Only the six structural scenarios that need no blackboard/async/managed-node/cost-tagged leaf semantics are measured; the remainder are documented placeholders (see documentedNotYetImplementedScenarios).

PipelinedJobs and Auto are documented policy placeholders only (see documentedNotYetImplementedPolicies) -- neither is implemented, and no case in this report ever substitutes one of the three accepted fixed policies for either.
No performance pass/fail threshold or regression bound is inferred from these numbers.
Thermal state and power policy are not controlled by the runner.
